title: The affine and projective lines
statement:
Over a finite field $F$ from the coefficient setup, the projective line
$\mathbf P^1_F$ is the projective space over $\operatorname{Spec}F$ with
homogeneous coordinates $T_0,T_1$, that is, the base change
$\operatorname{Spec}F\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}\operatorname{Proj}\mathbf Z[T_0,T_1]$
of the integral model. Put $\mathbf A^1_F=\operatorname{Spec}F[t]$.
Concretely, $\mathbf P^1_F$ is obtained by gluing $\operatorname{Spec}F[t]$
to $\operatorname{Spec}F[z]$ along
$F[t,t^{-1}]=F[z,z^{-1}]$, with $t=T_1/T_0$ and $z=t^{-1}=T_0/T_1$.
The first chart is $\mathbf A^1_F$ and its complement is the point
$\infty$ defined by $z=0$. Frobenius acts by $t\mapsto t^{|F|}$ and
$z\mapsto z^{|F|}$ on these charts.

lean.note: Existing interface for the entire definition: ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of F)) is the two-coordinate base-change model; AffineSpace.SpecIso identifies its affine chart domains with Spec F[t]; Line supplies the two charts, inverse-coordinate pullback and covering, singleton infinity complement, and both Frobenius equations. Homogeneous coordinate names are translated as source T_0 = upstream coordinate 1 and source T_1 = upstream coordinate 0; hence source t is upstream affineChart coordinate and source z is upstream infinityChart coordinate. This is a renaming of the two indeterminates of the integral model, not a change to either chart or the marked infinity. The primary declaration infinityChart and all Line declarations are defined in the recorded module; ProjectiveLine, ProjectiveSpace and AffineSpace.SpecIso are imported existing constituents, with their defining modules documented in report.md.
